title: Interactive 3D Portfolio
description: An immersive 3D portfolio showcasing personal projects and skills using React Three Fiber.

title: Gideons Inferno
description: Wrote, edited, and published a full-length novel blending dark humor with speculative fiction. Gideon's Inferno follows a Navy veteran trapped by a supernatural lease in a bureaucratic nightmare where rent is paid in memories. The project demonstrates strengths in original storytelling, worldbuilding, character development, and genre fusion—drawing inspiration from Dante's Inferno, Kafka, and modern absurdist satire. Available in hardcover, paperback, and ebook formats.

title: Shift Happens
description: A novel and companion web app to a novel written, edited and published by the author. The novel is a psychological/existential thriller written from three first-person perspectives, exploring the themes of identity, trauma, and the human experience. The web app serves as an interactive companion to the novel, providing additional content and resources for readers.

title: Arya's Day
description: A pet tracking app that helps monitor daily routines, nutrition, and health of pets.

title: Task Manager
description: A productivity tool to manage tasks efficiently, integrating intuitive UI and task priorities.

title: Dreamscape Generator
description: AI-driven app generating surreal 3D dream environments based on user input.

title: Slang Savant
description: An interactive phrasebook of current and relevant slang in six different languages.

title: Slot Machine Norse Theme
description: Online slot machine game inspired by Norse mythology with interactive animations.
